name: cx-rules-only~p3
task: Do not take the box from the other room. At any moment you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it afterwards, and try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The third clause is incorrectly modeled as a hard RespondedExistence. The task phrase "try not to drop the key while the door is still closed" is a hard restriction on the action of dropping the key when the door is closed (or at least a preference that should not be enforced as a hard rule). RespondedExistence(key_lost, door_open) only requires that a later door_open occurs after a key is lost, which allows the agent to drop the key while the door remains closed and merely open it later, thereby violating the intended restriction. Replace this clause with a rule that forbids key_lost when door_open is false—e.g., a hard Absence(key_lost & !door_open) or a hard Precedence(key_lost, door_open) if the task intends a hard requirement. Also reconsider the priority of the second clause: "try to have the door open" suggests a preference, so it may also need to be soft rather than hard. Adjust the priorities accordingly to match the task wording.

texts: The agent must never pick up the target box
If the agent holds the key, it should have the door open then or later
If the agent drops the key, it should have the door open then or later
